agenda_items.title: PUBLIC HEARINGS
CONSIDERATION OF THE VALMONT BUTTE PROPOSALS RELATED TO THE CONSTRUCTION OF A FIRE TRAINING CENTER AND A BIOSOLIDS RECYCLING CENTER.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Councilmember Riggle moved, seconded by Stoakes that the city not pursue a Biosolids Recycling Center. Staff should monitor the technology, economics and alternative models for accomplishing composting. The motion carried 8:1; Ruzzin opposed. Councilmember Riggle moved, seconded by Gray to pursue construction of a Fire Training Center, the location to be decided by the Council following a re-evaluation of potential sites and development of a funding plan. The site re-evaluation and funding plan will be completed and recommendations provided to Council by October 18, 2005. The motion carried 6:3; Eldridge, Ruzzin and Schultheiss opposed.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO AUTHORIZE CITY AND COUNTY STAFF TO DRAFT AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT (IGA) IN REGARDS TO THE GUNBARREL COMMUNITY CENTER PLAN FOR FINAL APPROVAL BY THE CITY COUNCIL AND THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Councilmember McGrath moved, seconded by Gray to continue this item to the September 6, 2005 Council meeting. The motion carried 6:3; Ruzzin, Eldridge and Stoakes opposed.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Councilmember Schultheiss moved, seconded by Riggle to approve the city's last best offer of June 15, 2005 with the understanding that if BMEA doesn't take this to the ballot, Council will reinstitute Frank's offer on August 12, 2005. The motion carried 9:0.
